evidence.title: DiaRelay: Relaying Dialogue Context with a Constant-Size Memory for Emotion Recognition in Conversation

summary: Researchers introduce DiaRelay, an AI system that improves emotion recognition in dialogues by relaying context using a fixed-size memory. The approach aims to maintain efficiency while capturing nuanced emotional cues in conversations.
title: New AI Model DiaRelay Enhances Emotion Recognition in Conversations with Constant-Size Memory
